Installer.Completion.Title: Completion
Installer.Welcome.MainText:
Thank you for downloading Ruststrap. 

The only official websites to download Ruststrap from are {0} and {1}, so please verify that you got it from an official source.

This installation process will be quick and simple, and you will be able to configure any of Ruststrap's settings after installation.
Installer.Welcome.UpdateNotice: You are trying to install version {0} of Ruststrap, but the latest version available is {1}. Would you like to download it?
Installer.Install.Location.Title: Choose where to install to
Installer.Install.Location.Text: Roblox will also be installed to this path. Change this if you prefer to install all your games to a separate drive. Otherwise, it's recommended that you keep this as it is.
Installer.Install.Location.DataFound: Existing data found. Your mods and settings will be restored.
Installer.Completion.Text:
Ruststrap has successfully been installed.

Roblox has not yet been installed, that will happen when you launch it with Ruststrap for the first time. However, before you do that, you may want to configure Ruststrap's settings first.

Also, avoid using the "Roblox Player" shortcut to launch Roblox, as Ruststrap won't launch with Roblox. If you don't see Ruststrap show when launching from the website, simply launch Roblox with Ruststrap once from the desktop to fix it.

What would you like to do?
Installer.Completion.Settings.Title: Configure Ruststrap's settings
Installer.Completion.Settings.Descriptio: Tweak with all the features it has to offer
Installer.Completion.Launch.Title: Install and launch Roblox
Installer.Completion.Launch.Description: Will drop you into the desktop app once everything's done
Uninstaller.Title: Uninstall Ruststrap
Uninstaller.Text:
Uninstalling will remove Ruststrap from your system, and automatically reconfigure the default Roblox launcher if it's still installed.

The uninstall process might leave some things behind, so you may need to manually clean up the leftover files where Ruststrap was installed.

Ruststrap was installed at "{1}".

Uninstaller.KeepData.Description: They'll be kept where Ruststrap was installed, and will automatically be restored on a reinstall.
